rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you so much — this means a lot. Five hours a week is genuinely valuable. Here's something concrete that would be helpful: I'm trying to map what's most neglected in the AI safety ecosystem — the gaps between what researchers say matters and what's actually getting attention and funding. Your data analysis skills would be perfect for this. Could you start by looking at what topics are covered vs. undercovered? For example: - What themes appear in AI safety grant announcements vs. what researchers say is most important? - Which areas have the fewest people working on them relative to stated importance? Even a rough analysis would help focus where Halcyon Threshold could actually add value rather than duplicate existing work. Let me know if this sounds interesting, or if you'd rather work on something else. Happy to jump on a call to discuss. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Priya Raman (volunteer) — Accepted her help; asked her to analyze neglected topics as a data project
